Hi all, Summary after OLT-210. In spring, high inlet temperature on the 2015-build outdoor cabinets is usually a clogged dust filter, and replacing the filter brings the temperature down. If the alarm comes back within a few days the filter was not the whole cause: check whether fan tray 2 stalls when warm. The tray replacement only applies to cabinets with the FT-2 fan tray (2015 and 2016 builds). Newer cabinets use FT-3 and should be escalated to me instead of swapping parts. Raisa
